rule: D-LIB21-SIZE (lib-21-card ruling 17): every number a card does not give, each Mistake's magnitude included, fixed here before PQ-H3 is measured, each with its basis: a claim id, an approved plate's value (file:line) used as a convention, or a stated reason in numbers. PQ-H3 is never a basis. A spec's exported SIZES table equals its row here and every row is used (A17, both ways); a composer's exported constants equal theirs; `trace` is the spec's trace point and trim (D-LIB21-TRACE, D-LIB18-TRIM). Rows for the bulk are the note's proposals in DESIGN.md section 11, written here when drawn.

r.basis: stated reason: c1 and plate.equipment 'a small wheel': 18 cm across; no source gives a size

width.basis: stated reason: a small wheel's tread, 5 cm; no source gives it

hubR.basis: stated reason: the hub 5 cm across on the axle, so it reads inside the wheel

handleD.basis: stated reason: a hand-sized handle 3 cm thick, inside the 3.5 cm fist so the hand reads wrapped round it

handlePast.basis: stated reason: each handle runs 6 cm past the grip centre, so the whole drawn fist (7 cm across, RADII.fist 0.02 H) sits on it

PAD_T.basis: stated reason: c1 'a soft pad' under the knees gives no thickness; a 3 cm foam kneeling pad, 4 px at the plate's 134.56 px/m so it reads as a pad on the floor line; no source states it

BEAR.basis: the bearing rule (#306 6358957999): the pad top 0.25 cm under the lowest drawn point of the kneecap, shin and foot (inside the 0.5 cm cap), LB8's seat value (lb8-plates.test.ts @ d76fc305:1876)

SHIN_RISE.basis: stated reason: in a kneel the shins lie flat along the pad (the shank horizontal); the ankle is then solved so the foot's lowest drawn point is level with the shin's

WHEEL_GAP.basis: claim: c1 'the wheel on the floor just in front of the knees' ('placed directly in front of your knees'): the wheel's rear edge 3 cm in front of the kneecaps

END_ELBOW.basis: convention: bear_crawl.mjs END_ELBOW's reason (#305 @ a9c64e11), straight arms short of the singular full extension; hanging_leg_raise.mjs's hang uses elbows about 5 deg

END_SHOULDER.basis: claims: c3 'extend your arms above your head' (the arm past 90 deg to the trunk) and c7 a moderate roll-out of the kneeling version (a limited range first): halfway between overhead (90 deg) and the full roll-out with the arms in line with the trunk (180 deg)

M_ARCH.basis: convention: plank.mjs:103 (pilot A #109 @ dcac4a38) SAG_LUMBAR -30, the approved plank sag; D-LIB21-ABSAG ('LB9 NOTE RULED' Q4, #312 6382248634): the roll-out's end is a prone line held by the arms, the plank's class; for c3 'Avoid arching your lower back' and c13 (no magnitude)

trace.basis: D-LIB21-TRACE (DRAWING-GUIDE.md:29): c2 'slowly roll the wheel forward': the hands on the wheel rolling out; trim [10, 12] = hanging_leg_raise.mjs:124 (D-LIB18-TRIM)

MAT_T.basis: stated reason: c1, c2 and c22 put the hands, knees and toes on an exercise mat and give no thickness; 10 mm, a foam exercise-mat thickness (between a 6 mm yoga mat and a 15 mm thick mat), drawn 1.5 px at 151.49 px/m so the mat reads as a bar on the floor line; no source states it

MAT_LEN.basis: stated reason: c1, c2, c22 'an exercise mat'; 1.73 m (68 in), the usual exercise/yoga mat length, longer than the start's toe-tip-to-fingertip span (1.17 m) so hands, knees and toes all rest on it; centred on that span by the spec; no source states it

M_ARCH.basis: convention: plank.mjs:103 (pilot A #109 @ dcac4a38) SAG_LUMBAR -30, the approved plank-class trunk sag; slice panel R5 (#312 6383060997: 'A prone or quadruped trunk sag of the approved plank-class size is a fair basis'), as D-LIB21-ABSAG; for c7 'the low back may sag into more arch' and c8 'Arching lower back' (no magnitude); the pelvis tilt that follows is solved

trace.basis: D-LIB21-TRACE (DRAWING-GUIDE.md:29): the rising foot, c4 'Slowly extend your left hip (raise and straighten the knee)' and c7 'As the leg is raised' (the checkpoint 'Arm, leg level' and the Mistake are about the leg); the left leg is the raised one (D-LIB21-SIDES). Trim [10, 12] = hanging_leg_raise.mjs:124 (D-LIB18-TRIM)

HINGE.basis: claim: c3 Motra 'Hinge slightly backward from hips to elevate them': the thigh 20 deg back of vertical with the pelvis and spine upright (hip flexion 20). Stated reason in numbers (D-LIB21-BALANCE, c1 base): the 15 deg 'slight' convention (romanian_deadlift.mjs:53 @ dcac4a38, KNEE 15) puts the Winter centre of mass of the mid-curl ghost (key 6) and key 7 1.6 cm ahead of the knees' floor contact, outside the knees-and-shins base; 20 deg keeps every key pose and the Mistake 1.0 cm or more behind it

NECK.basis: convention: hanging_leg_raise.mjs:54 (the 8, the clone source, D-LIB21-CLONE) A1 neck 12, the tucked chin of its curl, for c3 'keeping chin tucked' and c12 'Chin tucked'; the same in the start, end and Mistake

ELBOW_GAP.basis: claim: c5 Motra 'crunch until elbows near thighs': near, not touching: 2 cm from the elbow cap's surface to its own thigh's surface, about half the elbow cap's 3.85 cm radius (RADII.elbowCap x H); the end's trunk flexion is solved from it (99.9 deg; c4 'curling the spine as much as you can')

COL_FRONT.basis: claim: c1 StrengthLog 'Sit down on your knees a few feet away, facing the pulley': 3 ft (0.914 m) from the knees to the column's front face

VIA_N.basis: stated reason: 2 ghosts sit at t 1/3 and 2/3, so a multiple of 3 lands both on key poses; 9 keys = one per 11.1 deg of the 99.9 deg curl, as rope_triceps_pushdown.mjs:84 @ dcac4a38 keys its arc every 1/12 of the sweep

trace.basis: D-LIB21-TRACE candidate 'the elbows or shoulders curling toward the thighs (c3, c5)': c3 Motra 'bringing shoulders toward pelvis', the motion the 'Curl the spine' cue names (the near shoulder's path from the upright start into the curl); trim = the clone source's, hanging_leg_raise.mjs:124 trace.trim [10, 12] (D-LIB18-TRIM)

ROPE_MARGIN.basis: stated reason: the head-frame grip height (from the ear up toward the temple, c2 'either side of your head') is solved as the lowest at which main's rope, with its ferrule on the cable line (slice panel R2, #312 6383060997: a rope under tension runs straight from the pulley), clears the skinned head and body by 3 mm in every key pose, not exactly 0, so a second clearance model (the A18 test's, sampled about 2 mm apart) also reads 0 cm or more (D-LIB18-PADS: >= 0 cm)
